# Job Description - Architecture Program Manager

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Job Descriptions](../README.md)**

---

> **Position**: Architecture Program Manager
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Principal Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Architecture Program Manager to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of enterprise architecture programs and initiatives within Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, ensuring successful delivery of architecture transformations while managing stakeholder relationships and organizational change.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#program-management--coordination]

### Program Management & Coordination

- Lead enterprise architecture programs and large-scale transformation initiatives
- Develop program plans, timelines, and resource allocation strategies for architecture projects
- Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders across multiple architecture workstreams
- Manage program risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful delivery
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#architecture-governance--process]

### Architecture Governance & Process

- Support Architecture Review Board (ARB) operations and governance processes
- Facilitate architecture governance meetings and decision-making forums
- Develop and maintain architecture program management processes and procedures
- Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture standards and methodologies
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#stakeholder-management--communication]

### Stakeholder Management & Communication

- Manage relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, and external partners
- Facilitate communication between architecture teams and organizational leadership
- Develop and deliver executive-level reports and presentations on architecture program status
- Support change management and organizational adoption of architecture initiatives
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#resource-management--planning]

### Resource Management & Planning

- Manage architecture program budgets and resource allocation
- Coordinate with HR and talent acquisition on architecture team staffing needs
- Plan and schedule architecture resources across multiple projects and initiatives
- Support vendor management and procurement for architecture tools and services
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#healthcare-transformation-leadership]

### Healthcare Transformation Leadership

- Lead digital transformation initiatives in healthcare and government sectors
- Support healthcare technology modernization and cloud transformation programs
- Coordinate compliance efforts for healthcare regulations (HIPAA, MITA, FedRAMP)
- Manage interoperability and data sharing initiative programs

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Project Management, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, or relevant field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 7+ years of experience in program management or project management
- **Required**: 3+ years of experience in technology transformation or enterprise architecture programs
- **Preferred**: 5+ years of experience in healthcare technology or government project management
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#core-program-management]

#### Core Program Management

- Advanced program and project management methodologies (PMI, Agile, SAFe)
- Resource planning and budget management
- Risk management and issue resolution
- Stakeholder management and communication
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#technology-program-leadership]

#### Technology Program Leadership

- Experience managing technology transformation and modernization programs
- Understanding of enterprise architecture principles and methodologies
- Knowledge of software development lifecycle and delivery methodologies
- Experience with cloud transformation and digital initiatives
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#healthcare-program-experience]

#### Healthcare Program Experience

- Healthcare technology program management experience
- Knowledge of healthcare compliance and regulatory requirements
- Understanding of government healthcare program operations
- Experience with healthcare interoperability and data sharing initiatives
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#tools--methodologies]

#### Tools & Methodologies

- Program management tools (Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps)
- Portfolio management and governance tools
- Financial planning and budget management systems
- Communication and collaboration platforms
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for program documentation
- Experience with AI assistants (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for project planning and reporting
- Generative AI tools for program analysis, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication
- AI agents for automating program management tasks and reporting workflows
page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#required]

#### Required

- **One of**: PMP (Project Management Professional), PgMP (Program Management Professional), or equivalent
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Program Consultant (SPC)
- TOGAF certification or enterprise architecture framework knowledge
- Healthcare project management certifications

---

[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#healthcare-industry-experience]

### Healthcare Industry Experience

- Deep experience with Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) programs
- Knowledge of state healthcare agency operations and transformation initiatives
- Understanding of CMS requirements and federal healthcare program compliance
- Experience with Population Health Management and value-based care transformations
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#technology-transformation]

### Technology Transformation

- Experience leading large-scale cloud transformation and modernization programs
- Knowledge of DevOps and agile transformation initiatives
- Understanding of data migration and system integration programs
- Experience with vendor management and technology procurement
- Experience managing Generative AI implementation programs and governance initiatives
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#organizational-leadership]

### Organizational Leadership

- Experience leading organizational change management initiatives
- Knowledge of business process transformation and optimization
- Understanding of organizational design and capability development
- Experience with merger and acquisition integration programs

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#program-leadership]

### Program Leadership

- **Strategic Planning**: Ability to develop and execute complex program strategies
- **Organizational Leadership**: Skills in leading cross-functional teams and initiatives
- **Change Management**: Expertise in organizational change and transformation leadership
- **Executive Communication**: Ability to communicate effectively with C-level executives
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#project--resource-management]

### Project & Resource Management

- **Program Execution**: Advanced skills in program planning and delivery
- **Resource Optimization**: Capability to optimize resource allocation and utilization
- **Risk Management**: Expertise in identifying and mitigating program risks
- **Financial Management**: Understanding of budget management and financial planning
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#stakeholder--relationship-management]

### Stakeholder & Relationship Management

- **Stakeholder Engagement**: Advanced stakeholder management and engagement skills
- **Conflict Resolution**: Ability to resolve conflicts and negotiate solutions
- **Vendor Management**: Experience managing vendor relationships and contracts
- **Partnership Development**: Skills in developing strategic partnerships and alliances
page_texts.29:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#healthcare--technology-acumen]

### Healthcare & Technology Acumen

- **Healthcare Domain**: Understanding of healthcare operations and technology
- **Technology Transformation**: Knowledge of technology modernization and transformation
- **Compliance Management**: Understanding of healthcare regulatory compliance
- **Innovation Leadership**: Ability to drive innovation and emerging technology adoption

---
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#program-delivery]

### Program Delivery

- Successfully deliver enterprise architecture programs on time, on budget, and within scope
- Ensure architecture programs meet business objectives and stakeholder expectations
- Maintain high levels of stakeholder satisfaction and engagement
- Drive measurable business value through architecture transformation initiatives
page_texts.32:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/architecture-program-manager.md#organizational-impact]

### Organizational Impact

- Build and maintain effective architecture governance and program management processes
- Support the growth and maturity of the Enterprise Architecture Practice
- Contribute to organizational culture change and architecture adoption
- Develop and mentor program management capabilities within the organization
